decision: owner decision R31, 2026-10-28 (ADR-0126): best models first, matched to each role's needs

method.noise_band: 1.96 * 50 / sqrt(nq) points (95% half-width, worst case p=0.5)
method.v1_nq: not published in the v1 table; 50 assumed (NOT-PROVEN)
method.bucket: a bucket takes every model within the noise band of its best remaining score
method.inside_bucket: larger monthly allowance first, then higher score, then route key
method.unscored: after the scored routes of the tier: larger allowance first, then route key
method.tiers: OPENCODE_GO first, then OPENROUTER_FREE (PUBLIC only: eligibility filters it for INTERNAL)
method.never_listed: Gemini 4 Argon, Qwen 3.8 Max (API family the broker does not support), DeepSeek
method.effect: re-orders routes that are already eligible; never makes a route eligible
